description: This file defines an asynchronous logging worker class for handling log tasks efficiently, with queue management, flushing, and background processing, primarily used in the litellm project.

classes.name: LoggingTask
classes.description: A TypedDict representing a logging task with its associated context, including the coroutine to run and the execution context.

classes.name: LoggingWorker
classes.description: Asynchronous logging worker class that processes log tasks in the background, managing a queue, concurrent execution, and graceful shutdown.

methods.name: __init__( self, timeout: float = LOGGING_WORKER_MAX_TIME_PER_COROUTINE, max_queue_size: int = LOGGING_WORKER_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE, concurrency: int = LOGGING_WORKER_CONCURRENCY, )
methods.description: Initializes the LoggingWorker with configurable timeout, queue size, and concurrency.

methods.name: None start(self)
methods.description: Starts the worker loop and initializes the queue and semaphore.

methods.name: _process_log_task(self, task: LoggingTask, sem: asyncio.Semaphore)
methods.description: Runs a log task coroutine within its original context, handling exceptions and cleanup.

methods.name: None _worker_loop(self)
methods.description: Main background loop that fetches tasks from the queue and spawns processing coroutines.

methods.name: None enqueue(self, coroutine: Coroutine)
methods.description: Adds a coroutine to the log task queue, handling full queue conditions.

methods.name: bool _should_start_aggressive_clear(self)
methods.description: Determines if an aggressive queue clear should be initiated based on cooldown.

methods.name: None _mark_aggressive_clear_started(self)
methods.description: Marks that aggressive clearing has started, updating timing and status.

methods.name: None _handle_queue_full(self, task: LoggingTask)
methods.description: Handles the situation when the queue is full, either by starting aggressive clearing or scheduling retries.

methods.name: float _calculate_retry_delay(self)
methods.description: Calculates delay before retrying enqueuing a task after queue full condition.

methods.name: None _schedule_delayed_enqueue_retry(self, task: LoggingTask)
methods.description: Schedules a delayed attempt to re-enqueue a task after cooldown, preserving context.

methods.name: None _retry_enqueue_task(self, task: LoggingTask, delay: float)
methods.description: Performs delayed re-enqueue of a task after specified delay.

methods.name: list[LoggingTask] _extract_tasks_from_queue(self)
methods.description: Extracts a percentage of tasks from the queue for aggressive clearing.

methods.name: None _aggressively_clear_queue_async(self, new_task: Optional[LoggingTask] = None)
methods.description: Performs clubbing of queue clearing by processing multiple tasks concurrently during full queue situations.

methods.name: None _process_single_task(self, task: LoggingTask)
methods.description: Processes a single logged task, waiting for its completion and marking done.

methods.name: None _process_extracted_tasks(self, tasks: list[LoggingTask])
methods.description: Processes a list of tasks concurrently, used during queue clearing.

methods.name: ensure_initialized_and_enqueue(self, async_coroutine: Coroutine)
methods.description: Ensures the worker is initialized and enqueues a coroutine.

methods.name: None stop(self)
methods.description: Gracefully stops the worker, cancelling ongoing tasks and cleaning up.

methods.name: None flush(self)
methods.description: Flushes all remaining tasks in the queue.

methods.name: clear_queue(self)
methods.description: Clear the queue by processing tasks up to a maximum time limit.

methods.name: None _safe_log(self, level: str, message: str)
methods.description: Internal method for safe logging during shutdown, suppressing logging errors.

methods.name: _flush_on_exit(self)
methods.description: Ensures remaining log events are processed during program shutdown via an atexit handler.

methods.name: None _ensure_queue(self)
methods.description: unavailable
